question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes the rules for the sun-storey?
premises: The colophon identifies the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
The subject is the rule for the sun-storey.
inference: The thirty-eighth chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa, on the rule for the sun-storey, concludes here.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, on the rule for the sun-storey, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
